claims.text: The Arabic original carries the same two statements: King Abdullah's death at 1 a.m. on 'this day, Friday' 3/4/1436 AH; Salman's pledge as King under the Basic Law; and Muqrin's pledge as Crown Prince under item Second of Royal Order A/86. Its dateline reads Riyadh 2 Rabi II 1436 / 22 January 2015, and its trailer records filing at 02:33 Makkah time.
claims.locator: Dateline; both Royal Court statements; trailer
claims.uncertainty: The dateline is one day earlier than the day of death in its own body. The portal publication time, 2015-01-22T23:34:02Z, is 02:34 Makkah time on 23 January, after the 1 a.m. death, so the release was filed early on 23 January under the previous day's dateline. The body date is used; the dateline is treated as a filing artefact.

scope_note: published_date is the Makkah-time publication day from the portal timestamp (02:34 on 23 January 2015); the printed dateline, 22 January, is recorded in the claim. Used for SA-EXEC-05.
